R4797.summary: A ciphered slip on the Milan-Ferrara league: the league between the Duke of Milan and the Marquis of Ferrara against the Venetians and their league, the Duke of Milan having given 'madonna Biancha' to messer Leonello, the Marquis's son, and 'grandissimi facti' to be expected. The clear memorandum on the same sheet (paragraphs 5-7) is its contemporary decipherment; the key rebuilt from the alignment reads all 166 signs.
R4797.en:
to [make] chapters and a league between the [Duke of Milan] and the Marquis of Ferrara, to make …

… the [Venetians] and their league …

The [Duke of Milan] had given Madonna Bianca to messer Leonello, the Marquis's son …

… and it cannot fail that in this you will hear of very great deeds.

snip.cap: No. 8, the slip: clear cursive with Anchora disse and e stato antiveduto questo, the rest in cipher
snip.credit: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 8, via DECODE R4797

system: Simple substitution in letter-like signs, two signs for a and one for s/ss, with two name signs (duca di Milano, Viniziani).
